decisions: Separate customer-funded scheduled XRP purchases from card-point rewards, shareholder coupons and other promotional distributions.
Record SBI VC Trade Kantan Tsumitate as a confirmed recurring purchase mechanism: JPY 500–2,000,000 per order, daily/weekly/monthly, requiring prefunded JPY.
Do not convert product limits into an estimate of aggregate XRP demand; active plan count, XRP selection, filled units, sourcing and external venue are unknown.
Record card reward conversion as a monthly crypto-credit mechanism, not proof of open-market XRP buying.
Mark the Sep–Oct 2026 card application campaign closed as of 2026-11-01 01:29 JST; keep later card issuance, spending and reward-delivery dates distinct.
Do not admit these product mechanics as directional price features until actual XRP execution and inventory sourcing are measured.
required_verification: Obtain XRP-specific accumulation plan count and monthly JPY order/fill totals.
Reconcile SBI VC Trade execution records with external spot/OTC venue or market-maker inventory.
Obtain monthly card reward asset selection and XRP units credited.
Separate customer purchase demand from reward liability fulfillment and internal inventory transfers.
